messages:
morgan: Heads-up — eu-south1 apiserver 5xx spike during GPU pool scale at ~03:12 UTC. Noticed etcd leader flips and controller-manager restarts. Tagging SRE/oncall.
iris: saw that on the dashboard too. p95 apiserver latency jumped to ~1.2s, ~120 5xx/min for ~12m, then slowly recovered. Node attach waves coincide.
sam: can you paste the apiserver + etcd error snippets? any watch-cache / fd exhaustion messages?
morgan: quick grep from the apiserver logs (truncated):
```
I0312 03:12:14.123456 1 wrap.go:42] http: panic serving 10.0.0.12:52344: read tcp 10.0.0.5:6443->10.0.0.12:52344: read: connection reset by peer
E0312 03:12:15.987654 1 etcd.go:276] failed to watch keyspace: etcdserver: request timed out
E0312 03:12:16.000001 1 storage.go:98] failed to read from etcd: context deadline exceeded
```
morgan: also saw a bunch of `controller-manager` kubeclient errors and restarts around the same window.
kai: etcd metrics show leader elections ~3 in 10m, etcd grpc/rpc latency spiked. master-ssd NVMe iops peaked at same time. Looks like WAL/fsync contention.
iris: provisioner logs: we had an attach storm — autoscaler + many batch jobs attempted to attach ~120 GPUs in a 4m window. controller-manager workqueue depth spiked.
oncall: oncall: assigning temporary mitigation — rate-limited the gpu.attach API and paused the aggressive autoscaler window for eu-south1. Opened a short incident to track.
sam: rolling restarting apiserver will clear some stale fds but won't fix underlying i/o. We should throttle attach bursts and consider moving etcd to higher IOPS or NVMe backed if this repeats.
kai: proposed immediate steps:
- keep api rate-limit at 10 attaches/min for 6h
- bump controller-manager CPU from 300m -> 1 core (temp) and replicas 1->2
- increase etcd io-scheduler priority or move to io-optimized disk class for eu-south1 masters
- enable additional etcd metrics scraping and set alert at leader-election > 2 per 10m

iris: cost note — switching to io-optimized storage in eu-south1 estimated +28% monthly infra cost for that zone. Ops would prefer throttling + finer batching first and only escalate if recurrence. Can also investigate KV write batching on provisioner side.
morgan: agreed. I'll open an RFC: "eu-south1 etcd IO mitigation during GPU attach storms" and capture metrics + runbook. For immediate assignment: sam -> apply/verify rate-limit + controller-manager scale; kai -> monitor etcd elections / iops and validate disk metrics; iris -> prepare cost delta and alternative (throttle vs migrate).
sam: done: rate-limit set to 10 attaches/min (config-id: rl-2026-0312), controller-manager scaled to 2 replicas and CPU request bumped.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout started: controller-manager v1.2.3 -> eu-south1 (2 pods) — tracking rollout ID: roll-2026-0312-7
kai: update ~30m after mitigation: 5xxs down to baseline, leader flaps stopped, etcd commit latency back to normal. Continuing 1h monitoring.
iris: thanks — will post cost numbers and RFC link when ready.
morgan: good catch everyone. Closing thread for now; if symptoms reappear ping @oncall in this channel. :thumbsup:
